task: P1 definite initialization on every path

cases.description: A bare scalar with no initializer is read directly.
cases.note: Baseline positive control: the C+ checker already emits a tagged [CPLUS-LIFETIME] uninitialized diagnostic for a direct scalar read.

cases.category: raw pointer / owner on one branch
cases.description: A raw error * owner is assigned only on the true branch and read after the join.
cases.stderr:
tests/stdlib/agent1_handoff/definite_init/02_error_ptr_one_branch.cp:14:12: error: [CPLUS-LIFETIME] variable 'slot' is uninitialized (read before it is initialized)
      return slot->failed; /* uninitialized on the false path */
             ^~~~
cases.note: Tagged diagnostic produced. Definite-init for a raw pointer local is enforced across the branch.

cases.category: scalar out-parameter with a silent writer path
cases.description: A scalar out-parameter is written only on one path in the callee; the caller reads the uninitialized output after the call.
cases.stderr:
tests/stdlib/agent1_handoff/definite_init/03_scalar_outparam.cp:17:12: error: [CPLUS-LIFETIME] variable 'result' is uninitialized (read before it is initialized)
      return result; /* indeterminate when g_condition == 0 */
             ^~~~~~
cases.note: Tagged diagnostic produced. The checker sees that the callee may not write *out.

cases.description: A by-value RAII string owner is explicitly initialized only on the true branch, then consumed after the join.
cases.note: SILENT: check rc=0, no [CPLUS- diagnostic. Definite-init is not enforced for by-value class-typed owners.

cases.category: slice declared but not initialized on a path
cases.description: A borrowed slice is declared with no explicit initializer and assigned only on the true branch; size() is read after the join.
cases.note: SILENT: check rc=0, no [CPLUS- diagnostic. A strict unsanitized build also succeeds; its exit status depends on the uninitialized read (observed 20), confirming a genuine false negative.

cases.category: string_view declared but not initialized on a path
cases.description: A string_view is declared with no explicit initializer and assigned only on the true branch; size() is read after the join.
cases.note: SILENT: check rc=0, no [CPLUS- diagnostic. Strict unsanitized build succeeds; observed runtime exit 1 from the uninitialized read.

cases.category: loop with zero iterations then read
cases.description: The only write to a scalar is inside a loop that may execute zero times; the scalar is read afterwards.
cases.stderr:
tests/stdlib/agent1_handoff/definite_init/07_loop_zero_iterations.cp:11:12: error: [CPLUS-LIFETIME] variable 'last' is uninitialized (read before it is initialized)
      return last; /* indeterminate when the loop runs zero times */
             ^~~~
cases.note: Tagged diagnostic produced. The checker is path-sensitive for the zero-iteration path.

cases.category: early return leaves a guarded raw resource uninitialized
cases.description: An early return on the initialized path leaves both the guard flag and the guarded raw pointer uninitialized on the fall-through path.
cases.stderr:
tests/stdlib/agent1_handoff/definite_init/08_early_return_guard_ptr.cp:18:9: error: [CPLUS-LIFETIME] variable 'ready' is uninitialized (read before it is initialized)
      if (ready)                   /* guard flag itself is uninitialized here */
          ^~~~~
tests/stdlib/agent1_handoff/definite_init/08_early_return_guard_ptr.cp:19:16: error: [CPLUS-LIFETIME] variable 'slot' is uninitialized (read before it is initialized)
          return slot->failed;     /* guarded resource also uninitialized */
                 ^~~~
cases.note: Tagged diagnostics produced for BOTH the guard flag and the guarded resource pointer.

cases.category: out-value stored in a struct field on one branch
cases.description: A struct field (error *slot) is written only on the true branch and dereferenced after the join.
cases.note: SILENT: check rc=0, no [CPLUS- diagnostic. Definite-init does not look through by-value aggregates; the strict unsanitized build succeeds with runtime exit 64.

cases.category: early return leaves a guarded resource aggregate uninitialized
cases.description: Same guarded-resource pattern as case 08, but the guard flag and resource pointer are fields of a by-value struct; the guard is never checked before the read.
cases.note: SILENT: check rc=0, no [CPLUS- diagnostic. Strict unsanitized build succeeds; the false path dereferences an uninitialized pointer and segfaults (exit 139).
